description: Implement 30 PostgreSQL Integration Tests for Security Contracts. Remove @pytest.mark.skip decorators from tests/security/test_authorization.py and convert to real integration tests covering: RBAC enforcement (10 tests), Brand Isolation (5 tests), Identity Extraction (5 tests), State Machine transitions (5 tests), W3/W5 workflow security (5 tests). All tests use real PostgreSQL database fixtures from conftest.py and verify authorization helpers enforce security boundaries. Depends on FEAT-001 infrastructure.
steps: Create tests/integration/test_security_integration.py with imports: pytest, pytest.mark.integration, pytest.mark.asyncio, AuthenticatedPrincipal from app.auth.types, authorization helpers from app.auth.authorization, HTTPException from fastapi, and db_session, workflow_repo fixtures from conftest

Implement 10 RBAC tests: (1) test_contract_admin_can_create_workflow - verify require_role(principal, 'contract_admin') allows workflow creation, (2) test_contract_viewer_denied_workflow_creation - verify 403 raised, (3) test_super_admin_bypasses_rbac - verify is_super_admin() returns True and bypasses checks, (4) test_infrastructure_portal_identity_bypasses_rbac - verify portal_identity='infrastructure' bypasses, (5) test_empty_roles_denies_privileged_operations - verify roles=[] raises 403, (6) test_case_insensitive_role_matching - verify 'Contract_Admin' matches 'contract_admin', (7) test_contract_reviewer_read_only - verify can list workflows but cannot create, (8) test_require_any_role_accepts_multiple - verify require_any_role(['contract_admin', 'contract_reviewer']) accepts either, (9) test_admin_token_type_with_contract_admin_role - verify tokenType='admin' + role='contract_admin' allowed, (10) test_rbac_denial_logs_warning - verify authorization failure logged at WARNING level

Implement 5 Brand Isolation tests: (1) test_same_brand_workflow_access_allowed - create workflow with brand='skillhub', verify user with brand='skillhub' can access via verify_brand_access(), (2) test_cross_brand_workflow_access_denied - verify user brand='techskills' cannot access workflow with brand='skillhub', raises 403, (3) test_infrastructure_user_cross_brand_bypass - verify user with brand=None can access any workflow brand, (4) test_brand_none_resource_requires_infrastructure - verify resource with brand=None denies regular users, allows infrastructure users, (5) test_candidate_upload_captures_requester_brand - create candidate with user brand='skillhub', verify candidate record has brand='skillhub'

Implement 5 Identity Extraction tests: (1) test_user_id_extracted_from_jwt - verify get_current_user() extracts user_id claim, (2) test_original_user_id_extraction - verify originalUserId claim maps to original_user_id field, (3) test_shadow_user_id_extraction - verify shadowUserId claim extracted for admin impersonation, (4) test_client_supplied_user_id_ignored - verify route handler uses principal['user_id'] from JWT, not request body user_id, (5) test_missing_user_id_claim_rejected - verify JWT without user_id claim raises 401

Implement 5 State Machine tests: (1) test_workflow_creation_initial_state - create workflow via workflow_repo, verify current_state='REQUESTED', (2) test_state_transition_recorded - create StateTransitionModel, verify from_state and to_state persisted, (3) test_approval_transitions_to_implementing - create workflow in AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL, approve, verify state='IMPLEMENTING', (4) test_reject_transitions_to_rejected - reject workflow, verify state='REJECTED', (5) test_invalid_state_transition_prevented - attempt transition from wrong state, verify StateTransitionModel prevents invalid transitions

Implement 5 W3/W5 Workflow Security tests: (1) test_candidate_validator_hash_verification - upload candidate, verify SHA-256 computed from file content not trusted client hash, (2) test_canonical_comparator_brand_independence_check - run comparison, verify hardcoded brand markers flagged, (3) test_placement_manifest_sealed_with_hash - generate manifest, verify manifest_sha256 field populated, (4) test_placement_approval_requires_contract_admin - attempt placement without contract_admin role, verify 403, (5) test_placement_manifest_tamper_detection - modify manifest, verify hash verification detects tampering

Remove @pytest.mark.skip decorators from tests/security/test_authorization.py lines 192, 203, 213, 400, 410, 420, 430, 440, 463, 473. Update each test to use db_session fixture and real database operations instead of 'pass' placeholder. Follow integration test pattern from test_repositories_integration.py

Verify all 30 tests by running: cd services/project-ai && pytest tests/integration/test_security_integration.py -v. All tests should pass with TEST_DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL configured. Verify tests/security/test_authorization.py skipped tests now run: pytest tests/security/test_authorization.py -v -k 'jwt or client_supplied or brand'
acceptance_criteria: 30 integration tests implemented in test_security_integration.py covering RBAC (10), Brand Isolation (5), Identity (5), State Machine (5), W3/W5 (5)
Tests use real PostgreSQL fixtures: db_session, workflow_repo, approval_repo, candidate_repo
All previously skipped tests in test_authorization.py converted to real integration tests
Security contracts verified: RBAC denies unauthorized access, brand isolation prevents cross-tenant access, identity spoofing prevented
verification: pytest tests/security/test_authorization.py -v — no skipped integration tests remain
grep -c '@pytest.mark.skip' tests/security/test_authorization.py — reduced count (legacy skips removed)
pytest tests/integration/ -v -k security — all security integration tests pass
